title: Product Manager / Sr. Product Manager (Backend)
description:
**About Sugar.fit**

At Sugar.fit, we are on a mission to reverse chronic metabolic diseases—starting with Type 2 diabetes and pre-diabetes—through a data-driven, compassionate, and deeply personalized approach. Combining Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) technology, precision nutrition, and expert medical coaching, we empower thousands of users across India to take control of their metabolic health and achieve sustainable outcomes.

**About the Role**

While our user-facing app delivers the daily experience, our backend systems are the true engine behind clinical reversal. We are looking for a
**Backend-Focused Product Manager / Senior Product Manager**
to own the core platform, data pipelines, and system architecture that power Sugar.fit’s consumer ecosystem.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of high-scale B2C operations, real-time IoT data ingestion, and internal care-delivery tools. You won’t just build APIs—you will architect the foundational platforms that connect continuous glucose monitors, diagnostic partners, health coaches, doctors, and end-users into one seamless, responsive ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Core Platform & System Architecture

* **Own the Backend Roadmap:**
  Define and execute the product strategy for Sugar.fit’s core backend systems, microservices, and platform infrastructure to support rapid B2C user growth.

* **IoT & Real-Time Data Pipelines:**
  Manage the ingestion, processing, and normalization of high-frequency biometric data from Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs), fitness trackers, and diagnostic labs.

* **Third-Party Integrations:**
  Lead end-to-end integrations with external ecosystems, including diagnostic logistics providers, pharmacy fulfillment networks, payment gateways, and communication engines (WhatsApp, push notifications, SMS).

2. Care-Delivery & Operational Tooling

* **Internal CRM & Clinical Engines:**
  Build and optimize the backend workflows, scheduling algorithms, and rule engines that power our doctors and health coaches, ensuring timely, personalized interventions for users.

* **Personalization & Recommendation Systems:**
  Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to build the backend infrastructure for automated health insights, metabolic scoring, and trigger-based user nudges.

3. Scale, Reliability & Security

* **Performance at B2C Scale:**
  Partner closely with Engineering Architects to define SLAs around system uptime, API latency, data consistency, and fault tolerance.

* **Health Data Governance:**
  Ensure all backend data storage, access controls, and data-sharing architectures strictly adhere to healthcare compliance, user privacy, and security standards.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **4–7 years of Product Management experience**
  in high-scale
  **B2C consumer internet**
  companies (e.g., Health-Tech, FinTech, E-Commerce, Hyperlocal Delivery, or EdTech).
  *Candidates with 6+ years and demonstrated ownership of large-scale platform charters will be considered for the Senior PM role.*

* **Strong Technical & Backend Depth:**
  Proven track record of owning non-UI/platform products—such as API ecosystems, payment/checkout engines, order management systems, logistics/supply chain backends, notification engines, or data platforms.

* **Architectural Fluency:**
  Comfortable discussing system design, database schemas, asynchronous workflows, webhook reliability, and API contracts with senior engineers without needing to write production code yourself.

* **Systems Thinking:**
  Ability to break down complex, multi-actor operational workflows (User $\leftrightarrow$ Device $\leftrightarrow$ Lab $\leftrightarrow$ Coach $\leftrightarrow$ Doctor) into scalable, modular backend services.

* **Data-First Mindset:**
  Strong proficiency in SQL and product analytics tools to independently query datasets, diagnose system bottlenecks, and measure the business impact of platform improvements.

* **B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or a related technical field**
  (or equivalent practical engineering experience prior to transitioning into Product Management) is strongly preferred.

**Success Metrics (What You Will Own)**

* **System Reliability & Latency:**
  API response times, CGM data sync success rates, and reduction in integration failure rates.

* **Operational Efficiency:**
  Coach/Doctor productivity metrics, automated workflow resolution rates, and reduction in manual ops interventions.

* **Fulfillment & Care SLAs:**
  Turnaround time (TAT) for diagnostic bookings, device shipments, and real-time clinical escalations.

**Why Join Sugar.fit?**

* **High-Impact Mission:**
  Your work directly translates to people lowering their blood sugar, reducing medication dependency, and reclaiming their health.

* **Complex Technical Challenges:**
  Solve unique problems combining hardware (CGM sensors), real-time biometric data streams, AI-driven health insights, and human-in-the-loop clinical care.

* **Ownership & Autonomy:**
  High-trust environment where you own the problem space end-to-end alongside top-tier engineers, clinicians, and designers.

title: Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Experience Tech
description:
**Description**
Are you eager to shape the future of video entertainment, from movies and TV shows to live sports events? Do you enjoy tackling complex challenges within large-scale systems? If so, we invite you to help build the future of entertainment with us at Prime Video!
  
  
Since its launch in 2007, Prime Video has been transforming the traditional television and movie industry. With a rapidly expanding library of high-quality content and availability in over 240 countries and territories, Prime Video is now a key strategic priority for Amazon. We invest heavily in acquiring, producing, and programming a diverse range of TV shows, movies, and live events. Our exclusive titles include "The Lord of the Rings," "The Boys," "The Wheel of Time," and "The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel," among others. Beyond our extensive On-Demand catalog, Prime Video offers a wide selection of Linear Channels and Live Sports, featuring major events like Thursday Night Football, the English Premier League, NBA, MLB, ATP tennis, French Open, and the UEFA Champions League. If this sparks your interest, read on!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable systems that power Prime Video’s streaming services.
* Define the architecture for our software, utilizing a broad range of technologies, programming languages, and systems.
* Implement and operate APIs that manage billions of playback start requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency content delivery.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence the overall technical strategy and contribute to the team’s long-term roadmap.
* Communicate effectively across teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with technical goals and project timelines.
* Apply creative problem-solving skills to address complex challenges.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and new technologies, integrating them where appropriate. Fluency in GenAI based developer efficiency tools is a plus.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, contributing to the overall growth and success of the engineering team.

A day in the life
  
  
As a software engineer on the Prime Video team, my day starts with diving into hands-on coding and technical problem-solving. I’m not just writing code—I’m helping to shape the architecture of complex systems that millions of people rely on every day. One of the most rewarding aspects of my role is seeing my work come to life when friends and family use Prime Video to watch their favorite shows and live sports.
  
  
My primary focus is on designing and maintaining the APIs that power every title on Prime Video. This involves creating highly reliable and low-latency systems that ensure users can start streaming their content with just a click. The challenges are unique, especially when it comes to managing the sheer scale of requests we handle daily. To tackle these, I leverage AWS technologies like EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, and CloudFront.
  
  
Collaboration is a significant aspect of my role. I collaborate with a cross-functional team to align our technical strategies and define our long-term roadmap. It’s exhilarating to influence decisions that will shape the future of Prime Video. Throughout the day, I alternate between deep focus on coding and brainstorming sessions with my teammates to tackle novel challenges.
  
  
Beyond the technical work, I also play a key role in mentoring junior engineers. Sharing my knowledge and seeing others grow is incredibly fulfilling. I’m always encouraged to push the boundaries of what’s possible, and I have the freedom to explore new ideas that can elevate our service to the next level.
  
  
At the end of the day, I know that the work I do directly contributes to a world-class viewing experience for millions of Prime Video users, and that’s a great feeling.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our team within Prime Video Commerce owns critical offer orchestration and pricing services that power the global commerce experience. Our systems determine pricing, apply promotions, compose bundles, and serve the right offer to the right customer across every Prime Video surface. We process millions of requests per second, operate across 100+ markets, and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction worldwide, spanning subscriptions, rentals, purchases, channels, and bundles.
  
  
The challenge is not scale alone. It is scale plus rapid change. We are expanding into dozens of new marketplaces each year, each with unique payment methods, regulatory requirements, and pricing models. We are building dynamic pricing capabilities, enabling promotional experiences for major commercial events, and evolving how offers are composed as the product portfolio grows. Every new market and every new offer type adds combinatorial complexity to a system that must remain correct, fast, and available.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior SDE who wants to own hard problems in a system where getting it wrong means a customer sees the wrong price, cannot complete their purchase, or misses an offer they should have seen. You will own services end-to-end, make architectural calls, ship to production, and operate what you build. The work is technical, the impact is immediate, and the problems do not come pre-solved.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and evolve offer orchestration and pricing services that determine what customers see globally, making architecture decisions for correctness, latency, and resilience
* Design systems that handle the combinatorial complexity of multi-market, multi-currency, multi-promotion offer serving at millions of TPS
* Investigate and resolve production issues that cross service boundaries, often requiring deep analysis of traffic patterns, caching behavior, and downstream dependencies to find non-obvious root causes
* Drive marketplace expansion from an engineering perspective: configuration, offer distribution, compliance requirements, and end-to-end validation across new territories
* Build and maintain operational health for Tier-1 services: stress testing, capacity planning, alarm tuning, scaling strategies, and incident prevention
* Propose and drive architectural improvements that reduce operational toil, improve system reliability, or eliminate classes of production defects, without waiting to be asked
* Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture guidance, helping engineers across the team make better decisions and grow in scope
* Leverage AI tooling strategically to accelerate engineering workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve development velocity while maintaining quality and ownership of all design decisions

A day in the life
  
  
One morning you are tracing why an offer disappeared for customers in a specific region, following the data flow through multiple services until you find the filtering logic that does not account for a lifecycle edge case. The next day you are designing how a new promotional pricing type should propagate through the offer pipeline without breaking existing business rules. Later in the week you are reviewing stress test results, comparing actual traffic distribution against test configurations, and filing a scaling request based on your analysis. On Friday you are pairing with a newer engineer on their first multi-market configuration change, helping them understand the compliance implications before they ship.
  
  
The work moves between deep technical investigation, system design, production operations, and people development. You will not do the same thing two days in a row.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are part of the Prime Video Commerce organization, based in Bengaluru. We own services that power offer serving, pricing, and commerce experiences for customers globally. Our scope spans pricing and promotions, offer composition, bundling, and international expansion across dozens of markets.
  
  
We work as part of a global engineering organization with counterparts across multiple locations and time zones. We respect time zones, value directness, and believe that the best engineering happens when people feel ownership over their domain and trust within their team. We are a high-ownership team where individual contributions are visible and impactful.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* 3+ years of distributed systems experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
* Experience building and operating high-availability services in production with demonstrated ownership of operational health

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments or e-commerce
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in technical support and experience with automation and any version control tools
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience with international expansion: regulatory compliance, local payment methods, market-specific configuration at scale
* Familiarity with caching strategies, traffic analysis, and capacity planning for high-TPS services
* Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI tools to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining quality standards
* Track record of identifying and driving improvements to operational health, testing practices, or development processes without explicit direction

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.
  
  
Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.
  
  
Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.
  
  
**About Sarvam**
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
  
  
****What this role promises you****
You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.
  
  
****What you'll do****

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.
  
  
****Who you are****
We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.
  
  

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

****Bonus points****

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

EngRadar / Sarvam
  
  
Software Development Engineer - Tejas
  
  
**Sarvam**
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India, developing a full-stack sovereign AI platform across research, models, infrastructure, and applications.
  
  
**Sarvam**

Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.
  
  
Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.
  
  
Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.
  
  
**About Sarvam**
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
  
  
**What This Role Promises You**
You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.
  
  
**Who You Are**
We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.
  
  

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description:
About Us

Mercari is Japan's biggest C2C marketplace founded in 2013 with the mission to “create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell”.

From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S.

We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit.

Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the “Mercari Culture Doc,” which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari’s culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Design, development, and operation of APIs using Go, Java or PHP
* Improving services and measuring effectiveness using quantitative and qualitative analysis on user behavior logs, etc.
* Design architecture and select middleware based on application requirements
* Microservice performance tuning, monitoring, and alert handling
* Working with PMs on a series of development tasks (plan, design, implementation, QA, release, etc.)
* Investigating inquiries from customer support or other development teams
* Conducting system operation tasks, including responding to alerts while on call
* Engineering Culture
* Technology Stack

Bold Challenges

* We are looking for people that are interested in our services, mission, and values, and want to work where engineers can go bold, use the latest technology, make autonomous decisions, and take on challenges at a rapid pace.

**Requirements**

Minimum Requirements

* **9+ years of experience**
  in backend design, development, and operation of APIs using Go, PHP, or Java
* Experience developing and operating systems for large-scale products, selecting technologies, and improving their codebase
* Experience in designing and developing databases (MySQL or similar RDBMS)
* Ability to design and develop products while considering performance and scalability
* Experience selecting middleware and designing software architecture
* Ability to take ownership and lead the software development process
* Good communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders and teammates on product development

Preferred Requirements

* Project management and/or team leadership
* Experience developing and operating systems using microservice architecture
* Cloud development experience (preferably GCP or AWS)
* Knowledge of and experience with databases (RDBMS/NoSQL), networks, Linux, monitoring systems, logging, and SLO/SLA
* Experience contributing to an open-source project

**Benefits**

**Employment Status: Full-time**

**Office Location : Bengaluru**

**Hybrid Workstyle : 2 days Work From Office**

* We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week
* To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
* We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About The Role**
Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.
  
  
The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.
  
  
We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What you'll do**

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality

**What we're looking for**

* 3-6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own

**Nice to have**

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency

**Why Blue Machines**
You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

description:
**About OnePay**
OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.
  
  
Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.
  
  
We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.
  
  
We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.
  
  
But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are
  
  

* Ready to run
* Hungry and driven by urgency
* Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
* Comfortable operating in motion

The role
  
  
Software Engineers at OnePay build the products & systems that serve our customers and run our company. Besides writing, reviewing, and shipping code, engineers collaborate with others across the company, from product, design, and data to, customer support, ops, and compliance. Software Engineers at OnePay are highly technical, communicative, and emotionally intelligent.
  
  
**This Role Is Responsible For**

* Working closely with other engineers to ship code. We enjoy collaboration and partnering on hard problems.
* Building and maintaining documentation. As a growing and remote organization, having the necessary docs are key to our success.
* Solving complex problems that arise at scale. We deal with real-world money movement, sensitive financial data at scale, and are creating novel financial mechanics with no real precedent.

You bring
  
  

* 4+ years professional experience building, shipping — and growing — non-trivial products & services.
* Professional experience building, shipping — and growing — non-trivial products & services.
* We are hiring at all levels of seniority for backend engineers.
* Passion for your craft and care for the people you work with. You value quality across code, communication, and culture.
* An act-like-an-owner mentality. We have a bias toward taking action.
* A desire to keep growing your skills, and an ability to learn quickly. We hope you’ll be here for a while, and there’s no better investment than in our people.
* The Triple H Factor: Hungry, Humble, Honest

Tools We Use
  
  
We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
* Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
* Monthly transport and work-from-home allowances
* A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process
  
  
**Our Process Varies By Role. Most Candidates Go Through**

* AI-assisted initial screen
* Interview with Talent Partner
* Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
* Team Interview
* Executive Interview
* Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. **Experience Profile**

title: Java Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
description:
We're Hiring: Backend Engineer (HMS) – MedOrbit, an AI-Native Hospital Platform

This isn't a "maintain a CRUD app" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals, runs the full clinical and operational spine of a hospital, and has 11 AI agents in production under clinician control. You'll build the backend that doctors, nurses, lab technicians, pharmacists and billing teams use every day.

Role Details

Position: Java Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)

Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On-site, 5 days a week)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–4 years

Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred

Mandatory: Hands-on experience developing Java microservice, Devops, Database, AWS cloud

About MedOrbit

MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One codebase serves 24 facility types, from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500-bed super-specialty hospital, pathology labs, imaging centres, dialysis chains, blood banks and retail pharmacies.

What You'll Do

Core HMS Modules

  Build and extend Java / Spring Boot microservices across patient registration, appointments, OPD/IPD workflows, bed management, lab orders, pharmacy inventory, billing and insurance claims

Design REST APIs and database schemas that work across 24 facility types without forking the codebase

mplement module licensing and multi-tenant data isolation so each hospital sees only what it has licensed

Healthcare Integrations

Work on ABDM flows: ABHA creation/linking, consent management, HIP/HIU data exchange

Build and maintain FHIR R4 resources, HL7 messages from lab analysers, and DICOM integration with PACS

Support NHCX claim submission and TPA workflows

AI Integration

Integrate Python-based AI services (ambient scribe, lab report intelligence, X-ray analysis, claim-denial guard) into the core platform

Build the APIs, queues and audit trails that let AI outputs appear inside doctor workflows, with clinician approval recorded every time

Reliability & Compliance

Write unit and integration tests, review code, and fix production issues quickly

Build audit logs, role-based access control, consent tracking and data-erasure features for DPDP and NABH compliance

Optimise queries and APIs for hospitals with high daily patient volumes

Tech Stack

Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Python (AI services), Docker, AWS, Git, CI/CD

What You Bring

Must-Have:

B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field (2024–2026 batches welcome)

Hands-on experience building an HMS, EHR/EMR, LIS, RIS, pharmacy or clinic management system. Be ready to walk us through the modules you built, the database design, and the problems you solved

Strong fundamentals in Java and Spring Boot

Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, joins, indexing and data modelling

Understanding of hospital workflows: patient registration → consultation → orders → billing → discharge

Working knowledge of Git, Docker and Linux

Clear communication – you'll work with doctors and hospital staff, not just engineers

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points!):

Exposure to FHIR, HL7, DICOM, ABDM, LOINC or ICD codes

Microservices architecture, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Redis caching

AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and CI/CD pipelines

Experience with insurance/TPA billing or GST-compliant invoicing

Basic Python or experience integrating ML/LLM services

Frontend exposure (React / Angular) for full-stack debugging

How We Work

Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and features are validated with real hospital users, not in a conference room.

Why Join AI Nexus?

Build a live HMS used by real hospitals from Day 1

Work on India's healthcare digital stack: ABDM, FHIR, NHCX

See how AI agents are built into a production hospital platform

Fast-track career growth in a high-potential health-tech startup

description:

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**About Vialto Labs (VLabs)**
Vialto Labs (VLabs) is responsible for redesigning how work is delivered in the tax and immigration service lines, as well as driving operational efficiency across Vialto’s functional areas using AI. The team builds and deploys novel AI-enabled solutions that directly improve productivity and increase delivery quality for our clients. VLabs is accountable for rapidly turning innovative experiments into production-ready deliverables at scale and embedding them into day-to-day operations. This team focuses on the highest-impact workflows, creating standardized, repeatable capabilities that can be deployed globally. Operating with a mandate for speed and measurable outcomes, VLabs works alongside service line, product, and platform leaders.

**Software Engineer with Python expertise**
to support and build
**Generative AI and agentic AI solutions**
on
**Microsoft Azure**
. This role is ideal for someone who has hands-on experience building production-grade AI applications using the
**Microsoft Agent Framework**
, modern backend engineering practices, and secure cloud-native architectures.
  
  
This role covers both the AI-enabled automation of service delivery processes, i.e. tax and immigration services, as well as the use of AI capabilities to streamline functional / back-office processes (e.g. Finance, HR etc.).
  
  
The ideal candidate has experience designing and deploying
**agentic systems**
, building
**evaluation harnesses**

* Design and integrate agent workflows, tool usage, orchestration, and workflow management patterns

* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes

title: Software Development Engineer, CAM
description:
**Description**
Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.
  
  
We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.
  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.
  
  
We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.
  
  
If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Founder's Office (Engineering)
description:
**OnArrival | Bengaluru | Full-time | Work directly with the CTO & Co-founder**

**About OnArrival**

At OnArrival, we’re building the technology infrastructure that powers the next generation of travel experiences.

Our platform enables fintechs, banks, consumer brands, and digital businesses to seamlessly embed travel into their products through APIs, SDKs, and intelligent infrastructure.

We’re building towards a future where travel is embedded everywhere, increasingly autonomous, and powered by AI.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an exceptionally resourceful, technically strong, and hands-on individual to join our Founder’s Office – Engineering.

Think of this role as being the CTO’s technical right hand.

You’ll work closely with the CTO across engineering initiatives, new product ideas, architecture, AI experimentation, internal tooling, and strategic technical projects.

You’ll also act as a trusted liaison between the CTO and engineering teams, product stakeholders, technology partners, and external collaborators.

But here’s the important part: This is a hands-on engineering role, not a project management or coordination role.

We want someone who can write code, build prototypes, investigate problems, understand complex systems, challenge technical decisions, and independently take projects from an idea to a working solution.

One day you could be building an AI agent. The next, exploring a new backend architecture, debugging an integration, or representing the CTO in a technical discussion.

You’ll be involved in both the thinking and the doing.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Build, Code & Experiment**

\* Write production-quality code and build working prototypes.

\* Personally own and deliver engineering projects from concept to deployment.

\* Build internal tools, developer utilities, automations, and AI-powered workflows.

\* Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and emerging technologies.

\* Work across APIs, backend systems, integrations, SDKs, and occasionally frontend applications.

\* Debug complex technical problems, investigate issues, and propose practical solutions.

\* Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and experimentation.

**2. Work Directly with the CTO**

\* Be deeply involved in the CTO’s ongoing technical initiatives and special projects.

\* Translate early-stage ideas and loosely defined problems into working solutions.

\* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making.

\* Research new tools, frameworks, and technologies, and make informed recommendations.

\* Understand the broader engineering vision and help translate it into tangible outcomes.

\* Take ownership of initiatives without requiring constant direction or follow-ups.

**3. Act as a Technical Liaison**

\* Represent the CTO in selected engineering discussions, technical reviews, and partner conversations.

\* Work closely with engineering leads, product teams, and external stakeholders.

\* Bridge communication between the CTO and various engineering initiatives.

\* Understand technical blockers, dependencies, and implementation challenges.

\* Ensure important technical decisions translate into actual engineering progress.

\* Coordinate execution when needed, while remaining actively involved in the technical work.

**4. Drive Special Engineering Projects**

\* Take on experimental or high-impact initiatives that don’t naturally belong to an existing engineering team.

\* Build proof-of-concepts to validate new product ideas and technical approaches.

\* Explore platform improvements, architectural changes, performance optimization, and developer productivity.

\* Collaborate with different engineering pods to move initiatives forward.

\* Help evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and third-party technologies.

\* Take promising prototypes through technical validation and handover or production deployment.

**5. Explore What’s Next**

\* Stay ahead of developments in AI engineering, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, and software architecture.

\* Experiment with emerging technologies before they become mainstream.

\* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, automate work, and improve engineering velocity.

\* Bring fresh ideas to the CTO, backed by actual experimentation rather than presentations alone.

\* Help shape how OnArrival uses AI internally and builds AI-native travel experiences.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Technical Skills**

\* 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience.

\* Strong programming ability in at least one modern backend or full-stack language, such as Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, Python, or Go.

\* Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and modern backend architectures.

\* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

\* Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, debugging, deployment, and engineering workflows.

\* Familiarity with LLMs, AI development tools, and modern AI-assisted software engineering.

\* Ability to independently build, test, deploy, and demonstrate working solutions.

\* Broad technical curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar stacks quickly.

**Beyond Engineering**

\* Exceptional ownership: You don’t wait to be told every step. You figure things out and get them done.

\* Strong communication: You can explain complex technical ideas clearly to engineers, business stakeholders, and external partners.

\* High agency: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and making progress independently.

\* Structured thinking: You can break complex, loosely defined problems into manageable solutions.

\* Confidence: You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions, and engaging with senior technical stakeholders.

\* Resourcefulness: You know when to build, when to automate, when to use AI, and when an existing tool is sufficient.

\* Discretion and reliability: You can be trusted with sensitive technical discussions, strategic initiatives, and responsibilities.

**Bonus Points If You**

\* Have worked in an early-stage or rapidly scaling technology startup.

\* Have been a founding engineer or independently built and launched products.

\* Have experience with AI agents, MCP, developer tooling, or LLM-powered applications.

\* Understand travel technology, fintech, APIs, or embedded platforms.

\* Have worked closely with founders, CTOs, or senior engineering leaders.

\* Enjoy hackathons, side projects, open-source contributions, and experimentation.

\* Are comfortable interacting with partners, vendors, and developer communities.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Within your first 3–6 months, we expect you to:**

\* Independently ship meaningful engineering projects and working prototypes.

\* Develop a strong understanding of OnArrival’s technology stack and engineering priorities.

\* Become a trusted technical extension of the CTO.

\* Take ownership of special projects with minimal supervision.

\* Build strong working relationships with engineering leads and product teams.

\* Help accelerate technical decisions, experimentation, and execution.

\* Free up the CTO’s bandwidth without introducing unnecessary coordination overhead.

**What This Role Is Not**

\* Not an executive assistant.

\* Not a traditional project manager or scrum master.

\* Not a role focused primarily on tracking tasks, preparing reports, or scheduling meetings.

\* Not a strategy-only position where engineering is delegated to other teams.

\* Not a role where you’ll spend all your time in meetings.

You’ll be expected to write code, solve technical problems, and ship actual software.

**Why Join?**

\* Direct founder exposure: Work alongside the CTO on some of the company’s most important technology initiatives.

\* Real engineering ownership: Build, experiment, architect, and ship without unnecessary layers.

\* Technical breadth: Work across AI, APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms.

\* Freedom to experiment: Explore new technologies and turn ideas into working products.

\* High-impact work: Your contributions can directly influence OnArrival’s architecture, engineering productivity, and future products.

\* Accelerated growth: Develop the technical, product, and leadership judgment required to become an exceptional engineering leader.

**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here**

* You’re probably the person who builds things over the weekend because you’re curious.
* You enjoy coding, but you’re equally interested in understanding why something should be built.
* You can jump from a technical architecture discussion to writing an API, then explain the solution to a stakeholder without losing context.
* You don’t need perfectly written requirements to get started. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, and build something.
* You like being close to decisions, taking responsibility, and making things happen.

If you’re someone who loves engineering, enjoys working with founders, and wants to be involved in building what’s next, this role is for you.

**Join us in building the infrastructure for the future of travel.**

title: Senior Technical Lead - Real Time Platform
description:
**ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers!!
  
  
**ROLE SUMMARY:**
FTSE Russell (LSEG) is building the real-time platform that powers global index calculation across equity, fixed income, and multi-asset markets.
  
  
We’re looking for a hands-on
**Senior Technical**
**Lead**
to help modernise and scale this platform — a cloud-native, low-latency system that operates at global scale and underpins critical investment products used worldwide.
  
  
This is an
**individual contributor leadership role**
. You’ll lead through architecture, engineering quality, and delivery — designing resilient, event-driven systems, shaping technical direction, and raising standards across the team.
  
  
You’ll work on systems where
**performance, data quality, and reliability are non-negotiable**
, while leveraging modern cloud (AWS) and AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate delivery without compromising control.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

* Design and build real-time, event-driven systems that calculate and distribute index data with low latency and high reliability.
* Own platform architecture and engineering quality, leading through hands-on delivery, code review, and clear technical direction.
* Scale and operate a cloud-native platform on AWS, ensuring resilience, observability, and performance under real market conditions.
* Define and evolve data models and pipelines for market and reference data, with strong focus on accuracy, auditability, and control.
* Drive engineering standards and modernisation, using AI-assisted tooling and automation to improve delivery speed without compromising quality.

**Tech Stack**

* Development: Java, C#,, Python, SQL, OpenAPI.
* Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required).
* Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres.
* IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab.
* AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience designing and building distributed, event-driven systems.
* Proven ability to own system design and architecture, balancing performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Hands-on experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Solid understanding of data modelling and relational databases in production systems.
* Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and modern CI/CD practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through engineering quality — code reviews, testing strategy, and raising technical standards.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working on low-latency or real-time systems.
* Exposure to financial services, market data, or index products.
* Practical use of AI-assisted development tooling to improve engineering productivity.

**How We Work**
The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools.
  
  

* Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution.
* Customer driven. Work backwards from client needs and build products to address real-world problems.
* Technically courageous. Go beyond your comfort zone and push boundaries to deliver excellence.
* Learn and be curious. Continuously seek feedback, learn in formal and informal settings, actively share knowledge.
* Act as owners. Operate as though it is your business. Make thoughtful trade-offs and deliver long-term value.
* Lead with data. Validate assumptions, stay close to the details, act decisively.
* Build responsibly, deliver incrementally. Look for the small opportunities and milestones to build ambitious solutions.
* AI-native by default. Use AI tooling as a force multiplier, frame problems clearly, validate continually, and own the output.

**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and

title: Software Development Engineer, Customer Experience and Business Trends
description:
**Description**
Are you customer-obsessed, data oriented, and confident in proposing opportunities to improve our customers’ experience across different Amazon businesses? Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is looking for a scale-focused and customer-obsessed Software Development Engineer.
  
  
As an SDE, you will be part of a team that adds new capabilities to our customers through core engineering and AI/ML methodologies. The solutions heavily leverage technology to challenge conventional wisdom with hard data. Our SDEs solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.
  
  
In this role you will have the opportunity to exercise your creativity and explore ideas to simulate and quantify any aspect of the customer experience.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions for data collection and analysis platforms
* Build and optimize automated data collection frameworks across different surfaces (web, mobile)
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and implement efficient solutions
* Write high-quality, maintainable code while following best practices and design patterns
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation
* Debug production issues and implement performance improvements
* Work with ML technologies and LLM driven extraction services to enhance data processing capabilities
* Contribute to architecture decisions and technical strategy
* Mentor junior developers and participate in team's agile development process

A day in the life
  
  
You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other engineers to build tools that enable large-scale data collection and analysis. You'll tackle challenges ranging from Automated Data Collection framework development to building new features for our self-service tools, while ensuring high performance and reliability.
  
  
**About The Team**
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).
  
  
Our approach is based on determining the customer need, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds – including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Computer Vision experts, Solutions Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, Risk Managers, and more.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

delivers AI-powered parking management solutions that integrate computer vision, IoT,

and cloud SaaS to optimize parking operations.

As a Software Technical Lead at SHERRY, you will take end-to-end ownership of

designing, building, and maintaining critical software systems that power advanced

parking management solutions. This hands-on role emphasizes technical leadership,

architectural decision-making, and direct contribution to production code, while

mentoring and elevating the engineering team. You will collaborate closely with product

managers and architects to translate business needs into robust technical solutions,

ensuring reliability, scalability, and security across platforms.

SHERRY operates at the intersection of AI, IoT, and cloud technology, providing

innovative parking management software for operators and enterprises. With a focus on

computer vision, edge computing, and scalable SaaS platforms, SHERRY is committed

to transforming urban mobility and access control. The company fosters a culture of

technical excellence, continuous learning, and impactful product development, serving a

diverse range of clients in the smart city and mobility sectors.

Straatix Partners, Brigade Tech Park, Bangalore, 560066

Key Responsibilities

● Own the technical design, implementation, and production health of complex software

systems from architecture through deployment.

● Make architecture and technology decisions that balance immediate delivery with

long-term maintainability, documenting trade-offs.

● Write and review production code for critical system components, setting high standards

for code quality and reliability.

● Lead engineers through design and code reviews, providing mentorship and fostering a

culture of engineering excellence.

● Drive best practices in testing, automation, CI/CD, and observability to ensure robust

and scalable systems.

● Ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of owned systems, leading

root-cause investigations for production issues.

● Identify and address technical debt through practical, incremental improvements.

● Collaborate with product managers and architects to translate business requirements

into effective technical solutions.

Required Skills

● 12–15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years setting

technical direction for teams or major systems.

● Strong hands-on coding skills in Python or Java, with deep experience in backend

development.

● Proven expertise in designing distributed, cloud-native systems involving APIs, relational

databases, caching, messaging, and failure handling.

● Demonstrated ownership of systems in production, including incident response and

root-cause analysis.

● Experience with AWS, Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions.

● Familiarity with observability tools like OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.

● Ability to lead and influence engineers through technical expertise and clear

communication, without relying on authority.

● Sound technical judgment and the ability to explain trade-offs to both technical and

non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

Straatix Partners, Brigade Tech Park, Bangalore, 560066

license plate recognition using PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, or NVIDIA DeepStream.

● Edge or IoT experience with NVIDIA Jetson devices, RTSP camera streams, device fleet

management, and remote updates.

● Stream processing expertise with Kafka and Apache Flink, including stateful processing

and checkpointing.

● Production experience with enterprise SaaS security requirements such as SSO/OAuth,

multi-tenancy, audit logging, and SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
