title: Senior Principal Engineer - Jira Platform
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior Principal Backend Software Engineer to join our team, passionately focused on delivering creative improvements for our engineering teams.
  
  
**Your Future Org**
**“Jira Platform enables Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale.”**
As a Senior Principal Engineer In This Future Organization, You Will Help Turn This Vision Into Reality. You Will Shape The Platform Capabilities, Technical Strategy, And Engineering Practices That Enable Jira To Become The System Of Record And Control Plane For The Next Generation Of Human And Agent Teamwork. Our Work Is Guided By Three Forces That Will Power The Jira Platform Flywheel
  
  

* AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork, designing systems that enable people and AI agents to work together effectively.
* ENTERPRISE READINESS: Build the security, scale, resilience, and administrative capabilities required to earn the trust of the world’s largest and most demanding enterprises as they move to the Cloud.
* EFFICIENCY: Create a platform with sound unit economics that accelerates developer productivity, supports a growing agentic workload, and delivers world-class reliability for Jira Cloud customers.

**Your future team**
**Jira Data Management**
focuses on empowering users with effective control over the transfer and management of data within Jira Cloud. For enterprise customers, the capability to move and manage large volumes of data both within and outside their cloud site is essential for leveraging Atlassian's cloud offerings. We develop and support various data migration pathways for Jira products, facilitating transitions from Data Center to Cloud, Cloud to Cloud, and External to Cloud data migrations. Additionally, we offer data-shape management capabilities that power products like Site Optimizer for Jira. Our goal is to deliver scalable, seamless, and highly predictable data management solutions for Jira Cloud customers.
  
  
The JDM team comprises over 50 engineers, along with product managers and designers, dedicated to overcoming challenges that may hinder customers from fully utilizing our cloud offerings. Each feature we release has a direct impact on Atlassian's cloud revenue.
  
  
We are actively focused on improving reliability at scale, performance, and features for diverse product use cases built on our services. Currently, we are looking for individuals who are enthusiastic about tackling challenging tasks and who excel in a fast-paced environment. Our mission is high-profile, and we expect our team members to take initiative in driving and contributing to Atlassian's overarching objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical evolution and long-term architecture of Jira Data Management, shaping strategy for enterprise-scale data movement, governance, resiliency, and data health.
* Lead the largest architectural initiatives across Jira Platform, from strategy and milestones through delivery, adoption, and customer outcomes.
* Define and drive a 12–24 month roadmap for shared platform primitives, identify gaps, and make clear trade-offs on priorities.
* Raise standards for reliability, performance, observability, security, and operational excellence across systems handling critical enterprise data.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership via design reviews, deep investigations, incident reviews, and high-risk problem solving while mentoring Principal and senior engineers.

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience developing large scale distributed systems.
* 4+ years of experience providing architectural oversight and technical leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience at department-level: shaping technical direction across teams and influencing architecture beyond a single service.
* Track record of leading major architectural initiatives and turning multi-year strategy into incremental delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, data streaming platforms and event-driven architecture
* Broad knowledge of SaaS, PaaS, IaaS and hands-on experience with public clouds (ideally AWS and/or GCP).
* Fluency in any modern object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, Golang, Python, Javascript, go etc.) and in architecture patterns for distributed systems.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers, leading technical reviews, and improving engineering quality and productivity.
* Quick learner who excels in ambiguous environments.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer I
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a
**Forward Deployed Engineer I**
to join our Forward Deployed Engineering team, building production software that helps frontier AI labs solve real-world problems.
  
  
You'll partner with senior engineers to develop, deploy, and iterate on customer-facing solutions while working across the full software stack. As part of our growing engineering organization in India, you'll collaborate closely with teammates across India and have opportunities to work alongside Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US on high-impact customer initiatives.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems, learning quickly, and building software in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build and maintain production software supporting customer deployments
* Partner with senior engineers to design and deliver customer-facing solutions
* Collaborate with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams to build scalable production systems
* Develop full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, and modern backend technologies
* Help translate customer requirements into reliable, scalable software solutions
* Improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability
* Continuously learn, grow, and contribute to a rapidly evolving engineering organization

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong programming skills using TypeScript, React, and modern backend development
* Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), APIs, and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience building and maintaining production software
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US
* Experience working on customer-facing products or implementation projects
* Experience with AI-powered applications or machine learning infrastructure
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customer deployments launch successfully and deliver measurable value
* Production systems are reliable, scalable, and maintainable
* Engineering work helps accelerate customer adoption and platform growth
* You become a trusted contributor across engineering teams in both India and the US
* You continue to grow technically while helping build Handshake AI's engineering organization in India

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

**Perks**

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Staff Engineer ( Java )
description:
Job ID: R-2026-27-Q01-0011

Department: ETPL AI

Designation: Staff Engineer

Experience: 6-9 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore, India

**About ETPL**

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions.

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
* Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

To apply you can send your resume to prashant.musale@erelego.com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

title: Backend and Algorithms Engineer
description:
Ingersoll Rand is committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
  
  
**Role : Backend and Algorithm Engineer.**
**Level:**
Mid-level,Individual Contributor
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ years
  
  
**About The Role**
We build a data-driven platform that optimizes compressed air systems — compressors — under real-world operating constraints, including stability, safety, and performance. The algorithms this team develops translate live sensor data into operating decisions that reduce energy consumption, lower emissions, and generate cost savings for customers.
  
  
This role carries end-to-end ownership of algorithms: from the mathematical and control logic that determines how a compressor should behave, through to the production service that executes that decision continuously and safely in the field. For this hire, we are prioritizing engineering strength. We are seeking a candidate whose existing practices already reflect a rigorous, test-first, strongly typed approach to software, so that onboarding time is spent on domain context rather than on foundational engineering habits.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain production-grade Python services and automated pipelines to a consistently high standard of testing, type safety, and reliability.
* Design and implement optimization and control logic that translates physical and operational constraints into decisions executed by real compressors.
* Fit and calibrate models against noisy, real-world sensor data, exercising sound judgment about when a given fit or result cannot be trusted, such as in the presence of outliers, edge cases, or boundary behavior.
* Write tests prior to implementation as standard practice, using shared, reusable test fixtures rather than ad hoc, hardcoded test data.
* Carry projects from design through automated verification to production deployment, in close collaboration with a distributed core engineering team.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience building and shipping production Python systems, with demonstrated proficiency in type-hinted code and schema-first data models, as opposed to unstructured data passed between functions.
* Strong testing discipline, including test-first development, well-structured and reusable test fixtures, and a consistently high standard of test coverage as an established practice rather than an aspirational goal.
* Demonstrated ability to own a service across its full lifecycle: containerized, deployed through an automated pipeline, and operated within an orchestrated, multi-service infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of relational databases and at least one caching or eventing layer in a production environment.
* Familiarity with modern, reproducible dependency management practices for Python, in contrast to less structured approaches to package installation.
* Strong applied problem-solving ability in optimization or control logic, with demonstrated capacity to translate physical or operational constraints, such as stability, safety, or performance limits, into functioning algorithms rather than relying solely on off-the-shelf models.
* Experience fitting or calibrating models against real-world, noisy data, with sound judgment regarding the reliability of results.
* A disciplined approach to data and experimentation, including reproducible results, appropriate training and validation practices for time-ordered data, and awareness of data leakage risks.
* Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with a distributed team across time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with more than one cloud provider, or genuine interest in cloud migration work.
* Experience with workflow or pipeline orchestration systems, beyond request-response APIs.
* Academic or professional background in a physical or engineering discipline relevant to rotating or reciprocating machinery — thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, or mechanical/industrial systems — compressors being one example.
* Hands-on machine learning experience, which is valuable but secondary to the optimization and control skill set described above.
* An advanced degree in a quantitative or engineering field.

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

title: Senior Engineer (backend)
description:
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
As a Senior Backend Engineer at Sage, you will be responsible for building, enhancing and maintaining a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. You will proactively share your own knowledge for specific technical solutions and business processes in your area of responsibility. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of professional experience in backend engineering. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.
  
  
We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality.
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Core languages & runtime
  
  

* Strong TypeScript (strict mode) and Node.js (v24+) for production services.
* Solid computer-science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, async I/O.

Backend frameworks & APIs
  
  

* REST API design with Fastify (or Express/NestJS/Koa with willingness to learn Fastify).
* JSON Schema contract design and validation (AJV or equivalent); OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Understanding of API versioning, idempotency, pagination, and error-handling patterns.

Data & persistence
  
  

* Relational databases MySQL and/or PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning.
* Comfort with JSON-document modeling in a relational store and query compilation to SQL.
* SQL query builders (Knex or similar); parameterized queries and SQL-injection prevention.
* Caching with Redis.

Distributed systems & messaging
  
  

* Event-driven / message-queue systems (AWS SQS, or Kafka/RabbitMQ/SNS equivalents): producer/consumer patterns, dead-letter queues, retries/backoff, and idempotency.
* Designing for at-least-once delivery and eventual consistency.

Cloud & platform
  
  

* AWS services (SQS, EFS, S3, IAM, ECR) in a production context.
* Containerization with Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes deployments.

Security
  
  

* OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT validation (RS256, JWKS), token propagation, and multi-issuer auth.
* Secure coding against the OWASP Top 10; multi-tenant isolation and row-level security.

Testing & quality
  
  

* Unit, integration, and contract testing (Vitest/Jest or equivalent); test-driven mindset.
* Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline.

Tooling & workflow
  
  

* Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus.
* CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar).

AI Tooling
  
  

* Productive use of AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate day-to-day backend development.
* Integrating LLM / generative-AI capabilities into backend services (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) via SDKs, streaming responses, and prompt/response validation.
* Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): embeddings, vector stores/search, and context assembly pipelines.

Nice to Have
  
  

* MongoDB-like query languages or building a query compiler/DSL.
* KEDA / autoscaling on queue depth; Istio service mesh; Argo Rollouts canary deploys.
* GitOps (ArgoCD) and schema-driven DB migrations (Atlas or Liquibase/Flyway).
* Observability stacks: New Relic APM, Sumo Logic, Prometheus, Pino logging.
* Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, or accounting systems.
* Experience building AI/ML-powered backend features such as forecasting, anomaly detection, or natural-language querying over financial data.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Possess and apply a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of software development to the completion of difficult assignments.
* Successfully develop and maintain high-quality software (requirements, design, code, documentation, etc.)
* Work with product managers early on to shape product definition so that it can be built in flexible, extensible, and robust way
* Keep up to date with relevant technology areas and drive technical innovation.
* Automate tasks through appropriate tools and scripting
* Evaluates progress and results within own area, escalating recommendations for process changes to technical leadership.
* Partner effectively with all team members to deliver against commitments
* Deliver solid technical expertise within the team, contributing to a culture of innovation and execution
* Work cross-functionally with various Sage teams: product management, QA/XD, various product lines, or business units to deliver assigned work
* Mentoring and coaching junior members of the development team.
* Commitment to team success and positive team dynamics
* Passion for growing and applying technical skills in service to customers
* Extensive experience with Agile Development, SCRUM, and/or Extreme Programming methodologies
* Maintain relevant documentation to describe logic, coding/configuration, testing and changes where applicable.
* Ensure all tasks are completed to the required quality standards.

title: Backend Engineer - Crypto and Payments
description:
**About GoTyme**
The GoTyme Group builds digital banking products for customers in South Africa, the Philippines, and expansion markets across Asia and Africa.
  
  
GoTymeX is the Group's engineering, product, and design organisation. We build and run the software behind those products.
  
  
**About The Product**
We are building a stablecoin and digital-assets wallet that lets customers hold, send, receive, save, and spend digital dollars through a familiar banking experience.
  
  
The financial core will be delivered in stages. In the first phase, a managed CASP ledger remains the authoritative operational financial record. GoTyme will build immutable event and audit records, a financial-control projection, and reconciliation capabilities around it. In the next phase, GoTyme's event-sourced, append-only double-entry ledger will become the product and accounting source of truth.
  
  
The system must stay correct across vendor events, internal state, on-chain settlement, fiat payment rails, card settlement, fees, FX, holds, and operational exceptions.
  
  
**The role**
We are looking for a hands-on Core Backend Engineer with strong financial-systems and database experience to build Project White's ledger, posting, reconciliation, and financial-control capabilities.
  
  
You will build systems that calculate balances, record movements of value, prevent duplicate or missing postings, and explain each financial state change. You will work closely with finance, treasury, risk, compliance, operations, vendor-integration engineers, and senior engineers responsible for the wider financial-core design.
  
  
This is an online transactional-core role. It is not a reporting or data-warehouse position.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Build and improve an event-sourced, append-only double-entry ledger and its account, journal, posting, balance, hold, fee, FX, and adjustment models
* Implement posting rules and invariants that keep journals balanced, prevent unauthorised value creation or loss, and provide a clear audit trail
* Build transaction-processing flows for authorisation, holds, capture, settlement, reversals, refunds, chargebacks, expiry, corrections, and controlled manual adjustments
* Apply idempotency, deduplication, sequencing, and concurrency controls to payment, card, custody, and blockchain events that may arrive late or more than once
* Build reconciliation controls across the managed CASP ledger, Fireblocks, on-chain data, fiat ramps, card processing, treasury and accounting systems, and GoTyme's financial-control projection
* Build operational workflows for missing events, duplicate notifications, amount or currency mismatches, unbalanced postings, and suspense or repair processes
* Contribute to event schemas, financial data contracts, versioning, replay, and backfill approaches that preserve the audit trail without corrupting balances
* Work with finance and treasury to create accounting evidence, GL exports, reserve and liquidity views, and material for audits and regulators
* Apply strong practices for schema design, migrations, indexing, partitioning, data retention, backups, recovery testing, and database performance
* Take part in financial-core technical design and code reviews. Share what you learn about ledger modelling, database correctness, and safe production practices
* Own monitoring and production support for the components you build. Contribute to reconciliation service levels, incident response, root-cause analysis, and controlled remediation with the wider team

Why join
  
  

* Help build the financial foundations of a global stablecoin product as it moves from managed external infrastructure to a GoTyme-controlled financial core
* Solve database and distributed-systems problems where correctness protects real customer value
* Work with senior partners across engineering, finance, treasury, risk, compliance, and operations
* Shape the architecture and standards that keep the platform safe as it grows

**Requirements**
**Must-have**

* 5+ years of backend engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on work on payments, ledger, accounting, settlement, core banking, or another high-integrity transactional system
* Experience building, operating, or making substantial contributions to a double-entry ledger, payment posting engine, settlement platform, core-banking subsystem, or equivalent financial system of record
* Strong relational database and SQL skills, ideally PostgreSQL or MySQL. You understand schema modelling, transaction isolation, locking, concurrency, query performance, indexing, migrations, and recovery
* Working understanding of journals, debits and credits, chart of accounts, posting rules, available versus settled balance, holds, reversals, adjustments, fees, FX, and reconciliation
* Practical experience with idempotency, outbox and inbox patterns, event ordering, duplicate delivery, exactly-once-effect design, and failure recovery
* Experience building reconciliations that compare internal and external records, identify breaks, retain evidence, and support controlled repair
* Strong Java or Python experience and a record of building and operating reliable production services
* Experience with event-driven systems, including event replay, schema evolution, auditability, and eventual consistency
* Clear technical communication. You can work with finance, product, compliance, and operational partners to turn requirements into precise models and implementation decisions

**Strong plus**

* Experience in stablecoins, digital assets, crypto custody, exchange operations, or on-chain settlement
* Experience reconciling custody or ledger records to blockchain transaction events, confirmations, fees, and failed transactions
* Experience with Fireblocks, TigerBeetle, Modern Treasury, Mambu, Temenos, or similar financial-ledger or custody infrastructure
* Experience in card issuing or processing, payment acquiring, cross-border payments, treasury, FX, or regulated banking
* Experience with AWS serverless and event-driven services such as Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and Step Functions. Kafka is also useful where it is the selected event platform
* Experience designing data retention, partitioning, archival, and disaster-recovery approaches for financial records
* Experience with accounting exports, general-ledger integration, audit evidence, regulatory evidence, and operational controls
* Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a defined financial-core component

Technology and ways of working
  
  
You do not need experience with every item below. You should be comfortable choosing and applying the right patterns for a financial system of record.
  
  

* Financial core: An event-sourced, append-only double-entry ledger, a posting engine, financial-control projections, a reconciliation control tower, and accounting evidence
* Databases: Strong relational database skills are mandatory. PostgreSQL and MySQL are both relevant. Transactional correctness and performance matter more than a particular database brand
* Events and processing: AWS serverless patterns, including Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and workflows. Kafka may be used where it is the selected event platform. We use transactional outbox and inbox patterns and durable idempotency controls
* External records to reconcile: Managed CASP operational ledger, Fireblocks wallet and transaction events, blockchain data, fiat ramps, card processing, treasury, and the general ledger
* Engineering practice: Explicit financial invariants, peer review of financial changes, automated unit, integration, and contract tests, controlled migrations, reconciliation monitoring, staged rollout, and incident readiness

title: Backend and Algorithms Engineer
description:
Ingersoll Rand is committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
  
  
**Role : Backend and Algorithm Engineer.**
**Level:**
Mid-level,Individual Contributor
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ years
  
  
**About The Role**
We build a data-driven platform that optimizes compressed air systems — compressors — under real-world operating constraints, including stability, safety, and performance. The algorithms this team develops translate live sensor data into operating decisions that reduce energy consumption, lower emissions, and generate cost savings for customers.
  
  
This role carries end-to-end ownership of algorithms: from the mathematical and control logic that determines how a compressor should behave, through to the production service that executes that decision continuously and safely in the field. For this hire, we are prioritizing engineering strength. We are seeking a candidate whose existing practices already reflect a rigorous, test-first, strongly typed approach to software, so that onboarding time is spent on domain context rather than on foundational engineering habits.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain production-grade Python services and automated pipelines to a consistently high standard of testing, type safety, and reliability.
* Design and implement optimization and control logic that translates physical and operational constraints into decisions executed by real compressors.
* Fit and calibrate models against noisy, real-world sensor data, exercising sound judgment about when a given fit or result cannot be trusted, such as in the presence of outliers, edge cases, or boundary behavior.
* Write tests prior to implementation as standard practice, using shared, reusable test fixtures rather than ad hoc, hardcoded test data.
* Carry projects from design through automated verification to production deployment, in close collaboration with a distributed core engineering team.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience building and shipping production Python systems, with demonstrated proficiency in type-hinted code and schema-first data models, as opposed to unstructured data passed between functions.
* Strong testing discipline, including test-first development, well-structured and reusable test fixtures, and a consistently high standard of test coverage as an established practice rather than an aspirational goal.
* Demonstrated ability to own a service across its full lifecycle: containerized, deployed through an automated pipeline, and operated within an orchestrated, multi-service infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of relational databases and at least one caching or eventing layer in a production environment.
* Familiarity with modern, reproducible dependency management practices for Python, in contrast to less structured approaches to package installation.
* Strong applied problem-solving ability in optimization or control logic, with demonstrated capacity to translate physical or operational constraints, such as stability, safety, or performance limits, into functioning algorithms rather than relying solely on off-the-shelf models.
* Experience fitting or calibrating models against real-world, noisy data, with sound judgment regarding the reliability of results.
* A disciplined approach to data and experimentation, including reproducible results, appropriate training and validation practices for time-ordered data, and awareness of data leakage risks.
* Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with a distributed team across time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with more than one cloud provider, or genuine interest in cloud migration work.
* Experience with workflow or pipeline orchestration systems, beyond request-response APIs.
* Academic or professional background in a physical or engineering discipline relevant to rotating or reciprocating machinery — thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, or mechanical/industrial systems — compressors being one example.
* Hands-on machine learning experience, which is valuable but secondary to the optimization and control skill set described above.
* An advanced degree in a quantitative or engineering field.

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

description:
**Description**
**About the Role**
We are looking for an exceptional
**PMTS / LMTS**
to lead the engineering vision for
**AgentExchange’s Search and Personalization services**
— the AI-powered discovery layer that sits at the heart of how customers find and engage with solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer or Lead on the Search & Personalization team, you will be the technical authority for the systems that determine what customers see, find, and click on across AgentExchange. You’ll design and deliver the next generation of agentic search — multi-turn, context-aware, and enriched with AI overviews, next-best query suggestions, and personalized recommendations — alongside the indexing infrastructure and contextual discovery services that power embedded surfaces across Agentforce, Slack, Setup, and beyond.
  
  
AgentExchange is building the next generation of our ecosystem marketplace, extending the base and boundaries of our platform while infusing intelligence through every step of our partners’ and customers’ journey. The new ecosystem enables packaging, publishing, and listing solutions across multiple technologies — Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Slack — while delivering full transactability (Discover → Purchase → Provision). The One AppExchange Framework is our dynamic, extensible data and services platform that expands the tenancy capabilities of the AgentExchange site.
  
  
This is not a search-maintenance role. You will own the technical vision for discovery at scale, drive AI-native engineering across the search stack, and set the bar for relevance, latency, personalization, and observability across one of the most strategically important surfaces in the AgentExchange.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Architectural Leadership: Lead architectural design and delivery of major Search & Personalization capabilities, including:GenAI Search: AI overview results, next-best query suggestions, and natural language query understanding.Multi-Turn Agentic Search: Conversational discovery with recommendations, comparisons, and contextual follow-up.Personalization Service: Behavioral and preference-based ranking and recommendations.Contextual Discovery Service: Powering embedded AgentExchange discovery surfaces within Agentforce, Slack, Setup, and other core product surfaces.Search Indexer: Scalable, low-latency indexing pipelines for new asset types including standards-based agents, MCP tools/resources, skills, subagents, and A2A listings.
* AI-Native Engineering: Champion AI-native engineering — actively use and promote AI tools across the development lifecycle, from code completion to production monitoring. Model AI fluency and help build an AI-native team culture.
* Domain Strategy & Vision: Define the Northstar architecture for the Search & Personalization domain — leading discovery, design, and execution tracks that align with the broader AgentExchange one-marketplace strategy.
* Platform Modernization: Drive platform modernization — contribute to the migration off Heroku and onto Falcon, including the enabling roadmap for search services infrastructure migration.
* Engineering Excellence: Own engineering excellence across the search stack: observability and telemetry (SLOs/SLIs, latency budgets, relevance metrics), safe change practices, 99.95% availability targets, and security risk governance.
* Technical Authority & Mentorship: Act as the technical authority for your domain — providing guidance, mentorship, and sponsorship to senior and junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and bold innovation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Platform Services, Marketing and Growth, and Embedded Exchanges teams to deliver shared discovery infrastructure, unified catalog indexing, and contextual search surfaces across all AgentExchange touchpoints.
* Culture Carrier: Be a culture carrier — embody our values of Trust, Innovation, Engineering Commitment, and Curiosity. Challenge the status quo and build the best-engineered solutions.

**Requirements**

* Experience: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership on enterprise-scale search, recommendation, or personalization systems.
* Technical Vision: Proven ability to define and drive long-term technical vision and architectural roadmaps for large, complex search or ML-infused platform domains.
* Search System Expertise: Deep expertise in building and operating search systems at scale:Search Engine Internals: Indexing pipelines, ranking, query understanding, relevance tuning.Search Infrastructure: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or equivalent.Back End: Node.js, Java, or equivalent for high-throughput search services.
* Recommendation Systems: Experience designing and delivering recommendation or personalization systems — collaborative filtering, content-based ranking, behavioral signal processing, or equivalent.
* GenAI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or GenAI into search products — AI-generated summaries, query expansion, semantic search, or conversational retrieval.
* Data Pipelines: Experience with real-time and near-real-time data pipelines for indexing and signal ingestion.
* Production Reliability: Strong commitment to engineering excellence: observability, telemetry, latency SLOs, CI/CD, service ownership, safe change practices, and production reliability.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills — able to influence and build consensus across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Conversational Search: Experience building multi-turn or conversational search experiences, including context management and session-aware ranking.
* Agentic Systems & MCP: Hands-on experience with agentic systems, MCP tools/resources, or A2A patterns — particularly catalog and metadata requirements for new AI-native asset types.
* Embedded Surfaces: Experience with contextual or embedded discovery surfaces — delivering search within host product surfaces (e.g., in-app, in-builder, in-Slack contexts).
* E-Commerce Search: Familiarity with marketplace or e-commerce search — faceted navigation, intent classification, CTR optimization, and funnel instrumentation.
* Personalization at Scale: Experience with personalization at scale — user modeling, preference inference, A/B experimentation, and behavioral analytics.
* Platform Migrations: Experience with platform infrastructure migrations (e.g., Heroku → cloud-native platforms) and tech stack modernization.
* Security & Governance: Strong security mindset — experience with data governance, access control, and security best practices for search and recommendation systems.
* Salesforce Ecosystem: Conversant with Salesforce Platform features and best practices.
* Mindset & Language: A strong desire to learn technology and a polyglot attitude; proficient in written and spoken English.

**Our Engineering Values**
We hold ourselves to a high standard — because our partners and customers depend on us:
  
  

* Trust by default: Secure, accessible, performant, and scalable in everything we build.
* Engineering Commitment: Observability, performance, and security are first-class citizens, not afterthoughts.
* Curiosity & AI Fluency: We fully embrace AI across our daily engineering chores, from code completion to production monitoring.
* Boldness: We challenge the status quo and build the best-engineered solutions.
* Ownership: We don’t just ship features; we own the full lifecycle, including production.

title: Intermediate Backend Engineer - Code Security
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**Intermediate Backend Engineer, Security Factory: Code Security**
**An Overview Of This Role**
As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Security team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in the code they write and the open source components they depend on.
  
  
Your work connects dependency analysis, vulnerability detection, and automated remediation. You'll build parsing that tells the security analysis engine which libraries and frameworks a project uses, extend a service that turns security advisories into dependency update merge requests, and develop hybrid analyzers that combine rule-based detection with artificial intelligence (AI) reasoning. You'll help evaluate how well those analyzers find real vulnerabilities and expand coverage of libraries, frameworks, and AI agent tooling.
  
  
We use AI-assisted development tools in our daily work and expect you to use them effectively and with good judgment.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop secure, well-tested, performant parsing for dependency manifests, lockfiles, and software bills of materials (SBOMs). Extend support for new package ecosystems and formats in the analysis engine and remediation service.
* Build and apply analyzers that combine deterministic analysis with AI-driven analysis, working with the team's technical leadership. Review their results and measure false positives and missed findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.
* Create detection rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the test fixtures that prove they work.
* Contribute to packaging analyzers for continuous integration (CI) jobs, AI agent workflows, and command-line tools, reporting findings in GitLab's standard security report formats.
* Extend the automated remediation service, from running dependency updates in a sandbox to opening merge requests.
* Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity. Identify technical debt that slows the team down, and propose and implement improvements.
* Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.
* Participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't.
* Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Go and/or Rust. We use both, plus Ruby for remediation and Python for some analyzers, and value a willingness to work across them.
* A willingness to learn how vulnerabilities arise in code and the software supply chain, explore common vulnerability classes such as the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 and CWE, and apply static analysis to detect them. Deep expertise isn't required, and we'll help you develop it.
* The ability to organize your work and follow through on tasks independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.
* The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about technical problems and propose iterative solutions.
* Helpful, but not required: experience with containerized workflows and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or a willingness to learn them; package managers and dependency tooling such as npm, Maven, pip, Bundler, or Cargo; web or mobile frameworks; parsing, abstract syntax trees (ASTs), program analysis, or detection rules; or evaluating AI-driven detection against labeled data. We use Docker heavily.

**About The Team**
The Security Factory: Code Security team builds GitLab's code-level security scanning capabilities, spanning static application security testing (SAST) and dependency scanning.
  
  
We work closely with the Static Analysis team on GitLab's SAST engines, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Software Engineer - Backend Python
description:
**About Juicelabs**

*Where creative engineering meets applied AI.*

We build vertical, AI-native tools that unlock fresh insights and creative superpowers for clients in advertising, ecommerce, and beyond. We're a nimble team of founders and builders obsessed with using AI to solve real problems in ways that didn't exist eighteen months ago.

**The Opportunity**

A year ago, we would have posted this as a backend role. That role doesn't really exist any more.

Code has become nearly invisible. Agents write it, test it, and iterate on it faster than anyone could read it. What's left is the work above it: deciding what's worth building, designing systems that hold up at 10x, and building the setup that turns a clear spec into working software.

That's the job. At your level, it isn't one system. It's several workstreams, running at once.

You'll work directly with our Cofounder/CTO on products going from zero to one, with AI at the core of both what we build and how we build it. Real ownership, real scope, and an unusual amount of leverage: one engineer with good judgment and a well-tuned agent setup now ships what a small team used to.

**What you'll do**

* **Own multiple workstreams in parallel.**
  Two or three features of the same product moving at once, each with its own scope, edge cases, and failure modes. You decide where your attention goes this week, and nothing goes stale.
* **Run a fleet, not a single agent.**
  Design the setup that makes high-throughput work possible: how work gets broken down, specced, and run across many agents at once, so output scales without things breaking.
* **Design the system.**
  Service boundaries, data models, failure modes. Make the architectural calls before a line gets generated, and be able to explain the trade-off six months later.
* **Write the spec.**
  PRDs and technical designs are the new source code. A vague spec produces confidently wrong software, fast. Scope, edge cases, non-goals, what "done" means.
* **Own it end to end.**
  Ideation → design → build → deploy → monitor → iterate, including functional UX. Nobody hands you tickets.
* **Set the workflow.**
  Bring your harness: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, subagents, custom commands, eval loops — whatever makes agents reliable rather than merely impressive. We want to steal your good ideas.

**What we're looking for**

* **High agency.**
  You see the gap and close it. You don't wait for direction, and you don't need to be chased for follow-through. This is the single trait we screen hardest for. And you can do it across several workstreams at once, without dropping threads.
* **Real system design depth.**
  You can reason about consistency, caching, queues, and scale — and about complexity, because you need to know when an elegant-looking solution is quietly quadratic. LeetCode ninja not required. Being able to explain why this won't blow up at 10x, very much required.
* **Clear thinking, put to paper.**
  You get the thinking straight first, then write it down so nobody has to guess: PRDs, design docs, PR comments. Writing is most of how you'll direct both humans and models, and muddy thinking on paper becomes muddy software.
* **You've shipped to production.**
  Deployed things, monitored them, been paged by them, fixed them. Docker, CI/CD, cloud infra. Our stack is mostly Python (FastAPI), Postgres, GCP/AWS — but we care more about how you think than which framework you've memorised.
* **You orchestrate AI, not just use it.**
  Not "I've tried Copilot," and not just "I use Claude Code." You've run multiple agents in parallel and developed opinions: how to split work so they don't step on each other, where they excel, where they confidently lie, how you structure a repo so they don't wander, and how you verify what comes back at volume.
* **Startup energy.**
  Multiple hats, fast cycles, and the judgment to balance "ship it now" against "will this survive contact with real users?"

**Experience**

3–6 years of professional experience (full-time positions, excluding internships).

**Location / How to apply**

On-site at our office in HSR Layout, Bangalore.

Apply through this posting, or email join@juicelabs.ai with a link to the best thing you've built.

**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in PHP 8+ and Laravel. You will be a key architect in our shift toward a robust microservices and event-driven architecture. This isn’t just a "coding" role; we expect our seniors to be platform-aware, helping us move away from a "throw it over the wall" culture to one of true engineering ownership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architecture & Development: Design and implement scalable microservices using PHP 8.4 and Laravel.
* Infrastructure Ownership: Leverage AWS and Docker to deploy and manage services. We value engineers who can navigate container orchestration independently.
* Data Integrity: Optimize MySQL for transactional reliability and utilize MongoDB or Redis for high-performance data needs.
* Event-Driven Design: Build decoupled systems using asynchronous patterns (SQS/Event systems) to ensure marketplace resilience.
* Testing & Quality: Implement TDD (Unit and Integration) to protect our core revenue streams.

**Required Skills:**

* 5-8 years of Development experience
* Essential: Strong proficiency in PHP 8+ / Laravel, MySQL, and Docker.
* Experience: Proven track record in Microservices and Event-Driven Design.
* Cloud: Solid understanding of AWS core services.
* Desirable (The "Platform-Aware" edge): Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform).
* Knowledge of GoLang for high-performance services or Lambdas.
* Experience with OpenSearch and Redis.
* Familiarity with VueJS to assist in full-stack collaboration. ○ Knowledge of Kubernetes.

****About Arrive****
Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Backend Engineer E3 - Ecosystem
description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.
  
  
BitGo is looking for a
**Backend Engineer - E3**
who will join our Engineering team and help us build new features and applications for our enterprise clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Design and build strong, resilient, and robust APIs, libraries, and services to power our financial services: clearing and settlement, digital asset lending, trading and liquidity
* Own functionality and scalability features by taking responsibility from inception to deployment and customer integration
* Expose and document functionality to the UI, third-party developers, and our internal and external tooling
* Collaborate closely with all engineering teams to ensure consistency in understanding of technical requirements and overall work quality
* Provide mentorship to your peers in the broader engineering team through code reviews and education on best practices

**Skills & Experience:**
We are looking for teammates who share and practice our values: open communication, transparency, taking ownership, and a high level of craftsmanship. We are looking for coworkers who share our vision and mission: deliver trust in digital assets.
  
  
**Required**

* At least 6+ years of back-end, server-side software development
* Great at algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis
* Strong experience with server-side languages like TypeScript/Node.JS
* Strong experience with SQL databases like Postgres or MySQL
* Strong experience with RESTful API design
* Experience with unit and functional testing and debugging
* Experience with microservices and service-oriented architectures
* Experience in Git/GitHub and branching methodologies, code review tools, CI tools, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable with inclusion in on-call rotations for system support
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, applied mathematics, or another technical discipline from a top university
* Coordinate with stakeholders in the US and other global locations. This potentially involves taking night calls to keep in sync with your geographically distributed team

**Preferred**

* Experience in Financial Services and/or Financial Technology
* Experience with asynchronous programming
* Experience with functional programming
* Experience developing or supporting financial accounting systems, such as general ledger and bookkeeping functions
* Familiarity with digital asset trading, lending, and/or wallets
* Ability to work full-stack and familiarity with React
* Experience with large-scale, real-time, and distributed applications
* Experience working with clients and/or business partners
* Understanding and strong interest in cryptocurrencies and blockchain industry

**Why Join BitGo?**
Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.
  
  
Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:
  
  

* Competitive salary
* IT equipment support for work
* Meal and commute allowance
* Medical Insurance
* Attractive Well-being allowance (comprised of medical, wellness and fitness aspects)
* Snacks: on-the-house in the Bangalore office
* Great/Talented workforce to learn and grow with

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.
  
  
**Note:**
This role requires working onsite (Monday to Friday) at the Bangalore office.

title: Software Development Engineer III (Java Backend)
description:
At SIXT, we are engineering the future of mobility — one system at a time. As a Senior Backend Engineer in our BranchOps team, you will engineer the systems that power the full vehicle turnaround lifecycle and branch-level fleet orchestration, with deep integration into our IoT-connected fleet infrastructure. This is a role where backend engineering meets real-world operations at scale, in a team that builds with purpose and moves with pace. If this sounds like your next move, apply now and become part of something bigger.
  
  
**YOUR ROLE AT SIXT**

* You will design and build robust backend services in Java that power vehicle turnaround and fleet orchestration workflows
* You will contribute to the design and evolution of distributed, event-driven systems that operate at branch level and at global scale
* You will develop and maintain shared libraries and internal tooling that improve reliability and delivery speed across the BranchOps engineering team
* You will collaborate closely with product, operations, and engineering stakeholders to translate complex business workflows into scalable technical solutions
* You will actively integrate AI coding tools such as Claude and Cursor into your daily development workflow, helping to embed AI-assisted engineering as a standard practice within the team

**YOUR SKILLS MATTER**

* You hold a B.Tech, B.E., or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a closely related discipline
* You bring 9+ years of hands-on experience in sophisticated engineering environments — including cloud-native application development, scalability problem-solving, and event-driven system design, ideally within a start-up or scale-up setting
* You have strong, production-proven experience with Java and Spring Boot (must-have) and are confident navigating a modern microservices landscape end to end
* You have designed or operated distributed systems and microservices architectures, with a clear understanding of the trade-offs that come with operating at scale
* You have a solid grasp of event-driven patterns, pub-sub models, and message brokers such as Apache Kafka
* You actively use AI coding assistants — such as Cursor, Claude— to accelerate your work, while confidently recognising their limitations and knowing when engineering judgment must take precedence

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Grow Further, Go Further**
  Advance your skills and unlock your potential with our Education Assistance Program
* **Balance Your Career**
  Benefit from a hybrid work environment complemented by flexible working hours
* **Fuel Your Day**
  Great work deserves great fuel. Enjoy meal benefits that keep you energized and ready to bring your A-game
* **Your Wellness Matters**
  We're committed to your well-being through comprehensive insurance, wellness programs, health checkups, and fitness benefits
* **Recognition That Counts**
  We create a culture of appreciation, rewarding your impact through referral incentives and loyalty perks as you advance with us
* **Growing Families, Growing Joy**
  As your family grows, we're here to celebrate with a special newborn gift for your little one

**About us:**
We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!
